title: 第7章 指间陀螺第8章 销售天才
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 午后。
众人刚用过饭食，正在削竹子，就见早上猎妖队的那个黑衣男子御剑飞来。
落地之后，此人来到众人面前道：“我来是告诉你们一个好消息，昨晚袭击你们的那头妖兽已经死了。”
“这就死了？”
众人闻言大喜，李牧火更是长长松了口气，至少不用担心那妖兽会来报复自己了。
“你们在哪儿找到它的？”
吴道闻言也从院中赶来，好奇地追问。
却听着黑衣男子道：“那妖兽在矿山往北十里处被发现，发现它的时候就已经死了。你说他冲击炼器坊时好像就已经受了伤，估计是早有门中高手在追猎。”
“这倒是对上了，不过还是要感谢猎妖队确认了此事，否则我等怕是还要惴惴不安许久。”
吴道抱拳感谢。
黑衣男子微微点头：“不用客气，这本就是我猎妖会的职责。对了，此兽名为噬铁獠，喜食铁强身，应该就是你们说的偷矿贼。你们回头且注意着，看铁矿是否还会失窃，毕竟谁也不能确定这山野间就这一只噬铁獠。”
一阵寒暄道谢之后，吴道松了口气道：“你们也都听见了，危机基本算是解除了，可以放心了。李牧火，你就别在这搭建屋舍了，继续和秦力与开山一起，将那些铁镐锻造出来。早点儿让矿上开工，让宗门尽快把库房里的矿资拉走才更保险。”
“是，师父。”
片刻后，炼器房。
“铛铛铛！”
此刻的李牧火，心情愉悦，有种毫无后顾之忧的轻快。
锻打铁坯时，李牧火只觉相当轻松，充沛的气力配合十方聚气锤的运锤技巧，和昨天完全是天差地别般的体验。
不过，李牧火不敢锻打过分，明明能折叠百锻，他只进行了十锻，毕竟进步过于迅猛，免不了要被怀疑。
【你成功锻造了一柄中品凡器铁镐，获得3点天地精粹】
李牧火忍住了锻打上品凡器的想法，最终一天只打造了三柄中品铁镐和两柄下品铁镐交差。
可即便如此，也已经把大师兄和二师兄给震惊到了。
就连吴道都不禁侧目，李牧火只得承认铁骨功侥幸突破，这才解释过去。
日子就这般不紧不慢地悄悄流逝。
冬去春来，春去秋来。
转眼间便已过去三年。
自打噬铁獠袭击事件之后，山里的矿资就没再失窃过，大家的日子也归于平静。
而今李牧火已经十八岁，个头蹿到了一米八五，身材精壮却不臃肿宽厚，匀称得恰到好处，脸上的稚气也已敛去，显露几分俊气。
此刻。
李牧火和林越正站在炼器坊中央的空地上，一人握着一把刀，正在同步演练着。
这三年下来，林越的身体大幅好转，修行速度也猛提了上来，短短三年便晋升到了练气六层，这等天资让众人一度怀疑他当初为什么会被分到杂役弟子里面。
除了天资，林越的样貌也出落得越发英俊，加上他身上独有的贵气，曾有灵田谷的女修前来取器时，只远远看了他一眼，便隔三岔五地往炼器坊跑。
“错了。”
林越停下手上的动作，盯着李牧火，脸上露出几分恨铁不成钢的无奈道：“三年了，是头猪也该将这套刀法练至小成了，你竟然还只停留在熟练的阶段。”
“嘿嘿，师兄，我说了我资质很差，你又不信，非要让我练。练了，你又觉得我练得不好，要不我还是去练锤法吧？”
李牧火停下动作，挠头笑道。
“我……给我练。”
林越清喝一声，伸手抚着胸口，努力让自己平心静气，最后又轻哼了一声道：“你既然能用三年时间将铁骨功练至淬体三重，将十方锤炼至小成，代表你天资并不算很差，再来。”
“吃饭啦，快点儿~”
却听膳房方向，一个娇脆的声音传来。
只见，钱朵朵的脑袋探出膳房，眉眼带笑地催促着两人。
content_en:
Afternoon.
Everyone had just finished eating and was whittling bamboo when they saw the man in black from the demon hunting team flying over with a sword.
After landing, the man came to the crowd and said, "I'm here to tell you good news. The monster that attacked you last night is dead."
"You're going to die now?"
Everyone was overjoyed when they heard this, and Li Muhuo breathed a long sigh of relief. At least he no longer had to worry about the monster coming to retaliate against him.
"Where did you find it?"
Wu Dao also came from the courtyard after hearing this and asked curiously.
But I heard the man in black say: "The monster was found ten miles north of the mine. It was already dead when it was found. You said that he seemed to have been injured when he attacked the weapon refining workshop. It is estimated that there are masters in the sect who have been hunting him."
"That's right, but I still have to thank the Demon Hunting Team for confirming this matter, otherwise I might have been worried for a long time."
Wu Dao clasped his fists in thanks.
The man in black nodded slightly: "You're welcome, this is the duty of my Demon Hunting Club. By the way, this beast is called the Iron-eating Tiger. It likes to eat iron to strengthen its body. It should be the ore thief you call it. Look back and pay attention to see if the iron ore will be stolen again. After all, no one can be sure that there is only one Iron-Eating Bull in the mountains and fields."
After a while of greetings and thanks, Wu Dao breathed a sigh of relief and said: "You have all heard that the crisis has been basically resolved, so you can rest assured. Li Muhuo, please stop building a house here and continue to forge those iron pickaxes with Qin Li and Kaishan. It will be safer to start the mine as soon as possible and let the sect remove the mineral resources from the warehouse as soon as possible."
"Yes, Master."
A moment later, the weapon refining room.
"Clang clang clang!"
At this moment, Li Muhuo was in a happy mood, with a sense of lightness and no worries.
When forging the iron billet, Li Muhuo felt quite relaxed. The abundant strength combined with the hammer-handling skills of the Shifang Qi Hammer made it a completely different experience from yesterday.
However, Li Muhuo did not dare to overdo it. He could only do ten forgings even though he could fold a hundred forgings. After all, his progress was too rapid and he would inevitably be suspected.
[You successfully forged a middle-grade mortal iron pickaxe and obtained 3 points of heaven and earth essence]
Li Muhuo resisted the idea of forging high-grade mortal weapons, and in the end only made three mid-grade iron pickaxes and two low-grade iron pickaxes in one day.
But even so, the senior brother and second senior brother were shocked.
Even Wu Dao couldn't help but look sideways, and Li Muhuo had to admit that the iron bone skill was a lucky breakthrough before he explained it.
…
The days passed by quietly and unhurriedly.
Winter goes to spring, spring goes to autumn.
Three years have passed in the blink of an eye.
Since the attack by the Iron-Eater, the mineral resources in the mountains have not been stolen again, and everyone's life has become peaceful.
Now Li Muhuo is eighteen years old, and his height has jumped to 1.85 meters. His figure is strong but not bloated, and he is well-proportioned. The childishness on his face has also faded away, revealing a bit of handsomeness.
now.
Li Muhuo and Lin Yue were standing in the open space in the center of the weapon refining workshop, each holding a knife and practicing simultaneously.
Over the past three years, Lin Yue's health has improved significantly, and his cultivation speed has also increased dramatically. In just three years, he was promoted to the sixth level of Qi training. Such talent made everyone wonder why he was assigned to the handyman disciple in the first place.
In addition to his talent, Lin Yue's appearance also became more and more handsome. In addition, he had a unique nobility. When a female cultivator from Lingtian Valley came to pick up the weapon, she only glanced at him from a distance and ran to the weapon refining workshop every now and then.
"Wrong."
Lin Yue stopped what he was doing, stared at Li Muhuo, and said with a hint of helplessness on his face: "It's been three years, even a pig should have mastered this set of sword skills, but you are still only at the proficient stage."
"Hey, senior brother, I told you that my qualifications are very poor, but you don't believe me, so you insist on letting me practice. After practicing, you think I'm not good at practice, how about I practice hammering?"
Li Muhuo stopped, scratched his head and laughed.
"I... practice for me."
Lin Yueqing shouted, stretched out his hand to caress his chest, trying to calm himself down, and finally snorted softly and said: "Since you can practice Iron Bone Kung Fu to the third level of Body Tempering in three years and refine Shifang to Xiaocheng, it means that your talent is not very bad. Come again."
"It's time to eat, hurry up~"
But a delicate voice came from the direction of the dining room.
I saw Qian Duoduo's head sticking out of the dining room, urging the two of them with a smile on his face.
